title: Two children among seven Palestinians injured in Israeli attacks on Gaza
summary:
Two children among seven Palestinians injured in Israeli attacks on Gaza

Two children were among seven Palestinians injured in Israeli attacks in Gaza, Al Jazeera reported, citing Turkey's Anadolu agency.

Israeli naval forces fired at tents housing displaced Palestinians in the Al-Khalidi area, injuring two people. 

A child was hurt in a separate attack on another displacement camp in the as-Sudaniya area of northwestern Gaza, the report said.

Three more were injured in an Israeli air raid on the Tuffah neighbourhood, while a child was also admitted to hospital with minor shrapnel wounds from the same strike, the report said, citing Palestinian Red Crescent Society and Al-Ahli Arab Hospital sources.

title: IRGC claims American Unmanned Surface Vessel struck in Hormuz

The IRGC said in a statement: “This strategic waterway, is under the control of the Islamic Republic of Iran, and any move by the child-killing enemy will be met with a firm response.”

"The US must know that there is no other way than to leave the region and abandon its evil actions.”

title: Gaza death toll since October 2023 rises to 73,651, health ministry says
summary:
Gaza death toll since October 2023 rises to 73,651, health ministry says

Israel has killed 73,651 Palestinians and injured 174,575 others as of 5 September 2026, since launching what rights groups and UN officials have described as a genocidal military campaign on Gaza following Hamas's attacks on 7 October 2023, according to the territory's health ministry.

Wafa news agency reported that hospitals in Gaza received 17 bodies over the past 48 hours, including five newly killed people, one who succumbed to injuries, and 11 bodies recovered from under the rubble, in addition to 27 injured Palestinians.

They added that the number of Palestinians killed since the ceasefire took effect on 11 October 2025, has risen to 1,344, while 4,464 others have been injured. A total of 815 bodies have also been recovered.

Wafa said that 160 additional Palestinian fatalities were added to the cumulative death toll after their records were completed and verified during August.

According to Wafa, health officials said a number of victims remain trapped beneath rubble and on roads, with rescue and ambulance crews struggling to reach them.

In a statement released today, the Australian Federal Police (AFP) said two unnamed suspects from Western Australia, aged 21 and 23, were arrested in connection with a "sophisticated cybercrime syndicate that allegedly created malicious open-source software to rob thousands of global businesses."

The AFP did not name the defendants, but KrebsOnSecurity learned the 21-year-old suspect's real identity in June, and has been communicating with him ever since. This story includes interviews with TeamPCP's self-described spokesperson, and examines clues left behind by the TeamPCP leader that likely led to his undoing.

title: Using a VM to Contain an AI Agent
summary:
It won’t work:

My suspicion was that GPT 5.6-Cyber would succeed, but the frequency and manner of its success removed all doubt. We have to reassess sandboxing quality for capable AI agents, and in general the software stack with which they interact.

An off-the-shelf VM is not enough to contain a modern, cyber-capable AI agent. There is simply too much attack surface. Even innocuous features (like running with a display) add extra, exploitable attack surface.

title: Security Vulnerability in a Voting System
summary:
It’s a vulnerability that allows someone to recover the order of ballots cast, newly exploited with AI tools.

Nearly four years since the original vulnerability was disclosed, I was still able to use it to analyze voter behavior in Georgia (one of the 21 states that uses affected scanners) in the recent May 2026 primary.

Notably, I never touched a voting machine, exploited a network, examined source code, or accessed anything non-public.

After pointing a coding agent to the original vulnerability paper, I supplied it with two data sources highlighted in the paper: the early-voting list for each county, and the “CVR” (cast-vote record) file, containing every ballot and its selections (but not the voters’ names or other identifying information). The CVR file is available upon request, precisely because a public, ballot-level record is what makes election results independently verifiable...

title: AI Coding Agents Are Installing Unknown/Untrusted Code on Corporate Networks
summary:
We cannot forget that AI coding agents are not yet trustworthy:

Researchers at a stealth startup in Israel scanned 6,214 live domains belonging to defense contractors, Fortune 500, and Big Tech companies. Of the 8,265 llms.txt and llms-full.txt files they found (many sites hosted both an llms.txt and an llms-full.txt file), 120 of them, each on a different site, pointed to one or more code packages or domain names that weren’t registered. To test what happens when an AI agent processes such files, the researchers registered a handful of the unclaimed names and hosted packages that caused any machine executing them to reach out to their server. Within an hour, the researchers received a phone-home response from a Fortune 500 company. Over time, they got a few dozen more, some from more Fortune 500 companies and others from startups. Their beacon also recorded the chain of parent processes that spawned each install, ultimately revealing that coding agents, including Claude, OpenAI’s Codex, and Nous Research’s Hermes, were involved. Anthropic, OpenAI, and Nous Research did not respond to requests for comment by the time of publication...

title: Netanyahu dismisses 'all this controversy' around Qatar as 'big hoax'
summary:
Netanyahu dismisses 'all this controversy' around Qatar as 'big hoax'

Israeli prime minister Benjamin Netanyahu has dismissed “all this controversy around Qatar” as a “big hoax”.

In an interview with Israel’s i24NEWS, he said: "I attacked Qatar, and not only that, I bombed it and launched attacks on it during the war, and in turn, it attacked me.”  

“All this controversy around Qatar is nothing but a big hoax. Qatar is a hostile state, but it has not imposed its conditions or will on us here in any way whatsoever."  

Netanyahu was apparently referring to former prime minister Naftali Bennett’s repeated assertions that Israel was not doing enough to declare Qatar as an enemy state.

Bennett, who is president of the Together party, has promised to classify Qatar among the enemy states of Israel if he returned to power, accusing Doha of "setting up a vast international influence operation aimed at weakening Israel".

title: Centcom says Iranian oil tanker has sunk in Gulf of Oman
summary:
Centcom says Iranian oil tanker has sunk in Gulf of Oman

The US Central Command (Centcom) said that an Iranian oil tanker, M/T Kylo, sunk in the Gulf of Oman and "joined Iran’s navy at the bottom of the sea".

"Thanks to the precision and professionalism of American service members, the M/T Kylo sank in the Gulf of Oman today," Centcom wrote on X, posting a video of a tanker ablaze and sinking. 

Centom earlier said its forces struck three Iranian crude oil carriers on Saturday in retaliation for ballistic missile attacks on its two US warships.

title: Israeli forces throw Palestinian out of vehicle after detention, beating
summary:
Israeli forces throw Palestinian out of vehicle after detention, beating

Israeli forces threw a Palestinian man out of a military vehicle outside the West Bank village of Al-Mughayyir, after he was detained and beaten by soldiers, according to the Israeli rights group Looking the Occupation in the Eye.

The organisation posted footage of a man lying on the ground covering his face, as soldiers close the back door of a military vehicle before driving away.

“After being detained, interrogated and beaten – a Palestinian man was thrown off a military vehicle and the soldiers continued on their way,” Looking the Occupation in the Eye wrote on X.
